input_fields.name: current_selection_set
input_fields.description: Current selection identities before the toggle.

input_fields.name: target_object
input_fields.description: One visible target object to add/remove.

input_fields.name: navigation_mapping
input_fields.description: Verified controller capability/mapping for Ctrl+left click or an explicit equivalent.

result_fields.name: selection_state
result_fields.description: Before/after member sets, target identity, and toggle result.

procedure: Verify current selection and target identity; check controller support before holding Ctrl.
Use one calibrated Ctrl+left click, or stop and return a documented Select-mode/menu equivalent if available.
Observe before/after sets and require symmetric difference exactly {target_object}.
Return selection_state with direct_vs_equivalent control recorded.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous target/current set or unsupported Ctrl input without a verified equivalent.
Do not emulate Ctrl by repeated plain clicks.
Do not claim direct modifier automation when the controller cannot express it.
